Subject: Discovery recap + tri-region deep-dive timeslot baton

Hi Liam / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our 40-minute discovery: Medivue's priorities are (1) latency-sensitive patient summary generation, (2) strict data residency for EU records, and (3) a staged rollout across three internal teams with staggered windows.

Next step: we agreed it makes sense to run a technical deep-dive (30–45m) with your infra and security leads plus our serving-engine engineer. Because your teams span the US/UK/APAC, I'd like to propose a lightweight rotating "timeslot baton" so the same Redwood engineer can attend overlapping windows across regions without requiring duplicate sessions.

Attached: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (draft MAP) and tri_region_timeslot_grid.csv (example availability grid).

Could you share 2 preferred windows per region (local time with timezone) over the next two weeks? Once I have those I'll propose the initial 4-week rotation and lock the first two sessions.

Proposed quick option to save time:
- Week 1: US/EU overlap slot (preferred for initial network review)
- Week 2: EU/APAC overlap (security deep-dive)
- Week 3: US/APAC overlap (handoff, config)
- Week 4: follow-up ops + rollout plan

If that sounds reasonable I'll draft a simple rotating cadence and calendar invites.

Thanks —
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks for the availability, Liam — this is helpful. Quick proposal from our side for a low-friction rotating cadence that keeps the same two Redwood engineers (serving + infra) in a manageable window: 

Rotation model (4-week example):
- Week A (US/EU overlap): Tue 08:00 PDT / Tue 16:00 BST (UTC 15:00) — network + security review (45m)
- Week B (EU/APAC overlap): Wed 15:00 BST / Thu 00:00 SGT (UTC 14:00) — security deep-dive (45m)
- Week C (US/APAC overlap): Fri 08:00 PDT / Fri 20:30 IST (UTC 15:00) — infra/config (45m)
- Week D (Ops + rollout): Mon 09:00 PDT / Mon 17:00 BST (UTC 16:00) — follow-up and MAP alignment (30m)

Notes:
- We'll keep each session tight (30–45m) and circulate a short agenda 24h prior.
- If the APAC preferred times are too late for your team, we can swap Week B/C to reduce after-hours exposure.
- I'll draft calendar invites for weeks 1 and 2 (network/security and security deep-dive) once you confirm which of your suggested windows you prefer for those topics.

Scheduler link (option): https://cal.redwood.ai/karthik/30m (choose "Medivue - tri-region deep-dive")

Ben and I will be on the invites as backup. If that works we'll include a brief "how to reassign the baton" note in the MAP so your internal rotation can step in if someone is out.

—Karthik
